scope: Per-criterion author support with explicit real imports; independent learner and exact inaccessible-source gaps remain separate.

work.pool.consumer: mfn_pool_task calls hs_pool_sum; pool.c is an explicit hosted_systems dependency

coro.frame.consumer: ca_channel_deliver uses actual MsgHub with retained asynchronous tickets; McRead imports actual COAsync

sync.condition_queue.consumer: The new predicate/registration protocol is implemented from primitives; it does not claim to call the earlier copied-value queue

sync.spsc.consumer: Catalog publication/storage contract informs ordering prerequisites; the owner/multiple-thief deque is a separately implemented protocol, not an SPSC call-through

io.async.consumer: McLinuxPort implements real readiness/request/acknowledgement against the ownership contract; no undocumented legacy API is claimed

testing.faults.consumer: Admission, allocation and commit-phase controls implement declared fault schedules and separate oracles; there is no invented linked fault library
